High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Aditya Narayan Sharma - Advocate for the petitio

Heard on the question of admission as well as I.A.No.
 which is an application for stay.

Issue notice on admission as well as aforesaid I.A. t on payment of process fee by RAD mode within three working days, failing which this petition shall stand dismissed without further reference to the court.
Notice be made returnable within four weeks.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the accident has occured on 29.7.2023, i.e. after the amendment which has been brought in M.P. Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, w.e.f. 1.4.2022.,

The Tribunal in para 21 of the impugned judgment has arrived at the finding that the offending vehicle was being plied in breach of the terms of the policy and accordingly, directed the petitioner to pay and then recover from the driver and owner of the offending vehicle, which is not available in the amended Act.

Considering the submissions of the petitioner and on perusal of the findings of the court below, the operation of the impugned judgment shall remain stayed till the next date of hearing, subject to deposit 100% of the compensation amount before the Tribunal.
The Tribunal is directed to invest such amount in a Fixed Deposit in a nationalized bank.
The amount so 2 CR-435-2025 deposited shall not be disbursed without the leave of this court.
List on 8.12.2025 for confirmation of stay.
(DEEPAK KHOT) JUDGE HS Sbi General Insurance Co. Ltd. vs Lalu Prasad Choudhary on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142011017/
